title: the_gym_teacher_billed_my_church
display_title: My church's youth pastor found my parkour channel and read my username to the whole congregation
share_line: Send this to anyone whose youth pastor turned their hobby into a sermon.
beats: My youth pastor found my gaming channel and used my real name in front of 200 people, and I still haven't told my parents why I stopped going.
I'm 16M, and for a year I posted Minecraft parkour under a username I thought was anonymous.
Pastor Danny found it through my little brother's tablet, watched all 40 videos, and decided it was his business.
Next Sunday's youth sermon was about 'wasted hours' and 'digital idols' — and he said my channel name out loud, twice.
Kids I sat with every week turned around and stared, and someone laughed before he even finished the sentence.
I deleted the channel that night, told my parents I was 'just tired of it,' and I've made an excuse every Sunday since. AITAH for never correcting the lie?
